_readme: Real-photograph benchmark samples. Empty on purpose: the synthetic tier is
generated on the device and needs nothing here, and no photographs have been
supplied yet, so the harness reports this tier as NOT MEASURED rather than
guessing.
To add a sample:
1. Put the photo in assets/benchmark/real/ (e.g. kitchen_01.jpg).
2. Put its exact transcription in a .txt file next to it
(e.g. kitchen_01.txt). Type every character you can see, including
punctuation, or the score will blame the OCR for your omissions.
3. Add an entry below.
4. Rebuild: assets are compiled into the app, so hot reload is not enough.
Entry format:
"id": "kitchen_01",
"category": "blurry",
"image": "assets/benchmark/real/kitchen_01.jpg",
"groundTruth": "assets/benchmark/real/kitchen_01.txt",
"notes": "Nothing Phone (2a), dim kitchen light, hand-held"
category accepts: printedEnglish, printedHindi, mixedScript, blurry,
tilted, shadowed, lowResolution, smallFont, denseText, table, form.
An unknown or missing category falls back to the script of the reference text.
groundTruth may also be the transcription written inline instead of a .txt
path, which is fine for a couple of words but unreadable for a paragraph.
For a repeatable baseline, photograph stable, non-confidential pages, hold the
phone roughly 20-30 cm above the page, and record the device and lighting in
notes. Twenty to thirty samples covering the categories above is enough for a
first signal; do not treat any number from a handful of samples as a trend.
